Title: Customer Row Click Opens Customer Profile Page (Happy Path Access)
Section: Storefront > Sales Rep > Customer Profile > Gating
Preconditions:
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:SR_REP_PRIMARY]
Store setting SalesRep.Enabled=true on {{STORE_ID}}. SR_REP_PRIMARY serves @td(ORG_ACME.id) (has orders + a full address). ROUTE CONFIRMED (Phase 5 live navigation, vcptcore-qa sales-rep pr-2 / theme 2.54.0-pr-2383, 2026-07-17): the customer-profile route is /company/my-customers/{organizationId} — confirmed by direct navigation to /company/my-customers/@td(ORG_ACME.id); the My Customers row link uses this href.
Steps:
[NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}/company/my-customers
[WAIT] table rows loaded, row for @td(ORG_ACME.name) visible
[ACT] click the @td(ORG_ACME.name) row/customer-name cell
[WAIT] page navigates away from /company/my-customers
[WAIT] customer profile page rendered
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[API] salesRepCustomer(organizationId: @td(ORG_ACME.id)) query returns HTTP 200, errors[] empty (mirrors 050m SR-GQL-015)
[CONSOLE] no console errors on page load
[NETWORK] no 4xx/5xx on /graphql during page load
Failure_Signals: clicking the row does nothing / stays on the list page; 404 on the profile route; profile page shows the wrong organization's data; errors[] non-empty; console TypeError

Title: Module Disabled: Customer Profile Unreachable Even for a Permissioned Rep
Section: Storefront > Sales Rep > Customer Profile > Gating
Preconditions:
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
Requires an admin toggle of the store setting SalesRep.Enabled to false on {{STORE_ID}}, then signing in as SR_REP_PRIMARY (holds sales-rep:access). Disruptive to other concurrent testers on {{STORE_ID}} — run in an isolated window or accept as a one-off manual check, then restore SalesRep.Enabled=true immediately after. Mirrors 089 SR-FE-003 at the profile layer.
Steps:
[ADMIN] set store setting SalesRep.Enabled = false on {{STORE_ID}}
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:SR_REP_PRIMARY]
[NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}/account
[WAIT] account dashboard loaded
[NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}/company/my-customers
[WAIT] navigation settles
Assertions:
[DOM] "Sales Rep hub" section is absent from the left rail while the setting is disabled {DOC}
[NAV] the My Customers list and any customer-profile sub-route do not render (route not added — init() returns early per source, same as 089 SR-FE-003) {DOC}
